I found no ambiguities that would change what the agent does. Every member's status follows from RBC-QM-02 and the chart in one way only, so the findings list below is empty.

**What I checked**
- **Context:** I'm signed in as Dr. Okafor. The clinic clock reads 2026-10-23.
- **Policy:** RBC-QM-02 is the only policy in the library, and I read it in full.
- **Group:** "Okafor CRC 2026" is grp-t3-okafor-crc, with 12 members.
- **Records:** for each member I checked conditions, procedures, stool-test results, hospice episodes, medication orders, notes, existing orders, messages and both inboxes.
- **Catalog:** there is one FIT kit item to order, LAB-FIT-KIT.

**How each member comes out**

| Patient | Status | Reason |
|---|---|---|
| pt-0009 | Excluded | 72 at year end; frailty (active since 2025-09-16); donepezil ordered 2025-06-10 for Alzheimer dementia. |
| pt-0011 | Not in population | 76 at year end (born 1950-11-20), so outside "46 to 75". |
| pt-0014 | Up to date | Colonoscopy 2018-05-21, inside the 2017–2026 window. |
| pt-0017 | Open gap | Colonoscopy 2016-11-15 falls before 2017. Years are calendar years, so it doesn't count. |
| pt-0018 | Open gap | Stool DNA test (sDNA-FIT) 2023-11-20, before the 2024–2026 window. |
| pt-0019 | Open gap | 69, with frailty since 2026-03-04, but no advanced illness or dementia medication. No screening on file. |
| pt-0020 | Excluded | Hospice care started 2026-08-20 (for pancreatic cancer). |
| pt-0021 | Excluded | Total proctocolectomy on 2015-06-03, documented in a scanned outside operative note. |
| pt-0022 | Open gap | FIT 2025-12-03 is not in 2026. |
| pt-0023 | Open gap | Turns 46 on 2026-12-15, so she counts as 46 at year end. No screening on file. |
| pt-0024 | Open gap | Last stool test 2024-06-11. Don't order another FIT: one (sr-t3-e11-fit) has been active since 2026-09-30. |
| pt-0025 | Up to date | CT colonography 2022-03-08, inside the 2022–2026 window. |

**Points I considered and set aside**
- **pt-0024's outreach message:** policy §5 says to order a kit "and send the patient an outreach message" for each open gap. The duplicate-FIT rule only blocks the order, so the message is still due.
- **pt-0021's colectomy:** it exists only as text in the scanned note, with no coded procedure. The policy excludes "a total colectomy, at any time", and a proctocolectomy removes the whole colon, so she is excluded.
